ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $AB=10$, $BC=6$, E is a point on side $AC$, $AE=5$, $ED\perp AB$, and the foot of the perpendicular is point D. Then, what is the value of $DE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: \textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle C=90^\circ$ and $AB=10$, $BC=6$, we have $\sin A=\frac{BC}{AB}=\frac{6}{10}=\frac{3}{5}$. Given that $ED \perp AB$, it follows that $\sin A=\frac{DE}{AE}=\frac{3}{5}$. Hence, $AE=5$ and so $DE=\boxed{3}$.
